2126307404141007126.en_summary: It finds the strongest market leading stocks first and stocks making new highs breakouts and/or new PEGs making new highs. Then you want to track the best ones moving on volume in a bigger watchlist (i.e. the PEG watchlist). Then from there you'll start tracking and monitoring the individual stocks, one by one. Each stock will begin starting basing patterns in due time or pullback patterns to buy into (i.e. Holy Grail setups etc).
2126307404141007126.zh_summary: 它首先找出最強的市場領先股票以及創下新高突破和／或新 PEG 創下新高的股票。然後你想在更大的觀察清單（即 PEG 觀察清單）中追蹤成交量上表現最好的。接著從那裡開始逐一追蹤和監控個別股票。每隻股票會在適當時候開始形成基底模式或回調模式以供買入（即聖杯設置等）。

2126304264553144509.en_summary: BREAKING: S&P 500 is on track for a 4th consecutive week with a return of at least 2.5% in either direction, its longest such streak since the 2022 bear market. This would also match the 4-week streaks recorded during the 2020 sell-off and the 2000 decline following the Dot-com bust. By comparison, the record streak lasted 10 weeks during the 2008 Financial Crisis. This comes as the S&P 500 is up +3.9% so far this week, following a -8.6% weekly return last week. In the two weeks before last week's sell-off, the S&P 500 first declined -2.7% and then gained +2.5%. This volatility is an exceptional opportunity.
